normalization: Unicode NFKC; remove ZWJ/ZWNJ/BOM; normalize ي/ى→ی and ك→ک; remove Arabic diacritics; collapse whitespace; trim; lowercase for comparison only.
selection_rule: A capacity.campus pattern is retained only when it is an observed raw value whose normalized text contains the normalized program2s university.name, the prefix before that occurrence is empty, 'دانشگاه', or an observed استان/ادامه استان prefix, and the capacity province equals the program2s university province after normalization.
